changes: Expanded the ZEUS-only style catalog from four to nine reviewed presets.
Added RetroAmber and Monochrome palettes and Gamer Neon, Cyberpunk, Terminal green, Retro amber, and Monochrome presets.
Changing the theme or accent now updates the status message and keeps the ZEUS-only scope explicit.

portablePackage.smoke: main window opened, responded, and closed cleanly

limitations: These presets change only the ZEUS interface; they do not modify Windows wallpaper, taskbar, Start, system animations, or other desktop settings.
The development package is not signed with a production Authenticode certificate.
